reason: The hypothesis proposes a novel integration of MLIP-based structural sampling with targeted local DFT electronic scattering calculations to incorporate oxygen-induced potential fluctuations into Boltzmann transport predictions for HfNbTaTiZr. No passage combines these methods for electrical conductivity of this specific alloy with oxygen defects, nor addresses the 0–200 K and 300–1200 K regimes with a falsification test. The passages focus on mechanical properties (strength, ductility) using CPA and MTPs, not on electronic transport with defects.
copied_elements: MLIPs for large-scale structural sampling (P6, P7, P12)
DFT for local electronic structure (P4, P5)
